To our Programme

Chamäleon Berlin
in the Hackesche Höfe
Rosenthaler Straße 40/41
10178 Berlin-Mitte

info@chamaeleonberlin.com

Box Office

directly at the entrance to the Hackesche Höfe from Rosenthaler Straße

Opening Hours:

Tuesday through Friday: 3:00 pm to 8:00 pm
Saturday: 2:00 pm to 8:30 pm
Sunday: 2:00 pm to 6:00 pm
Monday: Closed

 

Directions

We recommend arriving by public transport:

S Hackescher Markt S3, S5, S7, S9, S75
U Weinmeisterstraße U8
Bus Linie 348, as well as night buses
MetroTram M4, M5, M6

Current restrictions in front of the Hackesche Höfe due to tram track construction:

From August 1 through October 22, 2026 (currently expected), Rosenthaler Straße between Hackescher Markt and Neue Schönhauser Straße will be completely closed to cars. Find more information here.
